draft:
What we have of Christ is the text, not a living chain of memory [[rzg.witness.what-we-have-of-christ]] [[as:paraphrase]].

No one among us met anyone who met him, and fifteen hundred years stand between his own life and ours [[rzg.witness.what-we-have-of-christ]] [[as:paraphrase]].

We hold the text to be enough on its own terms [[rzg.witness.what-we-have-of-christ]] [[as:paraphrase]].

Our own founder said so of himself, and we made his word our own rule [[rzg.witness.what-we-have-of-christ]] [[as:paraphrase]].

Where we have not rightly understood the Scriptures, we will be taught better, but only from the Scriptures themselves [[rzg.witness.what-we-have-of-christ]] [[as:paraphrase]].

We do not look to a chain of memory, because we do not possess one and do not need one [[rzg.witness.what-we-have-of-christ]] [[as:paraphrase]].
